scripts.build:chrome: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts && vite build --config vite.config.content.chrome.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('manifests/chrome.json','dist/chrome/manifest.json')"
scripts.build:firefox: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.firefox.ts && vite build --config vite.config.content.firefox.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.copyFileSync('manifests/firefox.json','dist/firefox/manifest.json')"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.release:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npm run pack:firefox
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/chat.test.mjs src/browser.test.mjs src/pageSupport.test.mjs src/extractionRecovery.test.mjs src/urlImport.test.mjs src/auth.test.mjs src/protectedRequests.test.mjs
